findings.text: A fourth Yearn strategy is an actual wstETH/WETH Spark loop. Four measured strategy debts plus idle WETH reconcile the parent book. The loop is absent from the default withdrawal queue and its borrower health factor is close to one.

At T, autoETH withdrawal simulations accepted 1% and 10% of whole-vault NAV but rejected 30%, despite sufficient caller shares. The decoded 30% error is PositivePriceRecoupNotCovered, a withdrawal pricing constraint, rather than evidence that the entire pool lacks assets. Getter maxima and cached NAV do not establish full liquidity.
mETH buffer counters reconcile cumulative gross interest, fee collection and net top-ups. Current capital cannot be used as the denominator for an annual yield on those cumulative flows.

Actual share marks replace forward APY assumptions, but still exclude separately distributed rewards and executable-exit costs. The autoETH quarterly decline is a book-mark observation, not a complete investor-return attribution.

YieldBasis fair price uses effective updated supply. It equals raw ERC-20 supply at T, but may differ while fees are pending. Staked and unstaked class marks partition one pool; the historical per-token price does not include staked gauge rewards.

Across the same sampled 732-day window, the four core product book-share marks grow less than unlevered stETH. Separate rewards and execution are excluded, so this does not establish complete investor or organic underperformance.

coverage.limitations: No new historical token payout receipt census was collected for these families. mETH cumulative contract counters are reported separately from receipt-level proof.
